message: The template '{0}' cannot be called with the type argument '{1}' because this type argument contains a run-time type parameter of the calling template.
title: A template cannot be called with a type argument that contains a run-time type parameter.
rationale: The message lacks an article before 'run-time template type parameter' and uses a contraction. The title speaks of 'run-time type parameters' of the called template, whereas the report site in TemplateAnnotator.VisitGenericName checks the type arguments of the call (run-time type parameters of the called template itself are LAMA0276).
